The form shown, q[9]_q[10]_q/(1-\delta_{\mathrm{CS}}), is the Chern-Simons tower resummed with the Gram factor \kappa set to 1; the -2.1\;\mathrm{ppm} is that form at the muon pin (-2.128\;\mathrm{ppm}). The derived \kappa is the Witten Gram-determinant ratio \approx 1.722, not 1, and at the standing proton pin the resummed residual is -468\;\mathrm{ppb}. That correction remains conjectural: \kappa is carried as an unproved Lean sorry (Chern-Simons correction).
